items.text: When I first tried an internal pre-release version of @eve, a personal shopper agent was my "hello world". It worked, but a lot of the infrastructure was missing. Now, @agentcardhq exists, models are better, iMessage and WhatsApp eve channels are mature, and performance is vastly improved (without trading off durability and encryption.) The result is you can ship a platform of the caliber of Muse / Instinct, that you fully control, on our open intelligence stack. The experience is pure delight. I highly recommend you try this. Run with this template. Make it your own.

items.title: This year we’ve had a clear jump in model capability where instead of telling agents precisely...
items.text: This year we’ve had a clear jump in model capability where instead of telling agents precisely what to do, it’s better to use these systems to solve problems you can’t easily define yourself. A year ago you’d need to very clearly tell agents the how to design and develop your product idea, or there was almost no chance of success. Now, increasingly, the agent likely can come up with a better implementation than you’d have thought of because you can have it connect the dots between a far greater solution space than you can. This will be increasingly true in basically every domain of kneeler work. We’re going to see this impact in finance, legal, life sciences, cyber, and many other spaces wh...
